slug: 2025-03-25 La Centrafrique lance officiellement e-Tax, sa plateforme de paiement d'impots en ligne

facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports that the Central African tax administration launched the e-Tax platform on 24 March 2025 for online payment of taxes, with online tax information, declaration and payment, in four modules including registration for the unique taxpayer identification number (NIU).
